links.outcome: Quality, safety omissions, and confabulation in chatbot answers to procedural sedation patient questions
links.effect: Response quality varied across chatbots; several answers had incomplete information, safety omissions, or potentially misleading statements. No numeric results reported in the abstract.
links.quote: The results demonstrated variability in response quality across chatbots, with several answers containing incomplete information, safety omissions, or potentially misleading statements.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLM chatbots responding to patient questions regarding procedural sedation to assess safety and accuracy; does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
